This is a pinned rules import, not an installation of the full upstream agent runtime.
HuntLab uses its existing single-copy-edit Agent stage with a stricter technical-content
preservation contract in `guides/humanize-experiment.md`. It does not claim AI detector
evasion, watermark removal, human authorship, AdSense approval or semantic correctness.
Upstream style grades and corpus observations are not HuntLab content-quality scores.
